name: LinkupAPI
desc: LinkupAPI lets agents send messages, manage conversations, and automate outreach across every channel, for sales and recruitment.

actions.name: list_accounts
actions.description: List all connected LinkedIn accounts linked to your API key. Free (0 credits). Use the returned account_id in other actions.

actions.name: get_account
actions.description: Get detailed information and status for a specific connected account. Free (0 credits).

actions.name: get_my_profile
actions.description: Retrieve the profile of the connected LinkedIn account.

actions.name: get_profile
actions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a LinkedIn profile by URL, public identifier, or URN.

actions.name: search_people
actions.description: Search LinkedIn profiles by keyword, company, title, location, school, industry and more. Returns the LinkedIn URL of each match.

actions.name: search_companies
actions.description: Search LinkedIn companies by keyword, location, sector and company size.

actions.name: get_company
actions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a LinkedIn company page.

actions.name: send_message
actions.description: Send a LinkedIn message to a profile, optionally with a media attachment.

actions.name: get_conversation
actions.description: Retrieve the message history of a LinkedIn conversation, by conversation ID or profile URL.

actions.name: send_connection_request
actions.description: Send a LinkedIn connection invitation to a profile, with an optional note.

actions.name: check_invitation_status
actions.description: Check the status of a connection invitation sent to a profile.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_message_received
triggers.description: Fires in real time when the connected LinkedIn account receives a new message. Registers a LinkupAPI webhook (≈10 credits/day per monitored account while active).

triggers.name: invitation_accepted
triggers.description: Fires in real time when a connection request sent from the connected LinkedIn account is accepted. Registers a LinkupAPI webhook (≈10 credits/day per monitored account while active).
